name: bge-m3-bangla
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of BAAI/bge-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568B parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-03-15. LoRA rank 32 / alpha 64 on 39,082 cross-script pairs. The base record's MIRACL/MTEB rows are a different instrument and are not comparable to these.

benchmarks.name: Average cross-script cosine similarity
benchmarks.config: Card 'Key Results' table, column Fine-tuned 0.788 vs column Base BGE-M3 0.689, on the author's Bangla/Banglish/mixed-script pair set (39,082 training examples).

benchmarks.name: Dev triplet accuracy %
benchmarks.config: Same table: 98.74% vs base 95.30%, dev split. Card also reports Retrieval Hit@1 1.000 vs 1.000 (tie, not recorded as a win) and admits pure-Bangla informal similarity fell 0.12.
